From the founder

450 years in the ground. Minutes in your hand. That is not a materials problem. That is a failure of imagination. We are early, and we will be wrong sometimes. But the maths only needs to be right once.

How we work

Everything is written in public. Every claim on this site carries a source or a label. And when something changes, the page changes - each one carries its date.
